★Request
Situation: Shaved ice and other items haven't been received from the shopkeeper yet.
Here, it carries the nuance of wanting them to receive her "feelings/gratitude" only.

■Stage Direction
SE: Sound of rummaging through bag
---
★Request
Fade to black *No questionnaire prop needed

★Request
Fade to black

■Stage Direction
SE: Footsteps walking away

Enduring the post-training hunger is tough for me, too.
To be honest, I want to eat right away.

You don't know?
Tonight from—... Mmh, this must be that thing.

Excuse me, Trainer.
Please take this before we start training.

Fufu. You're excited too, Trainer.
I understand... I'm thrilled as well.

Oguri Cap is acting restless.
Deciding not to question her further, I moved on to starting training.
...We can't do that. We shouldn't, Trainer.
...Please, try to understand.
No... Wouldn't this practically count as an appetizer?

...Mmh, what a dilemma.
For now, let's think about it after we finish training.

All that's left is to focus on training
and properly complete today's routine.

That said, shaved ice is practically a beverage, and
okonomiyaki is... Look at it, it's mostly cabbage.
Don't hold back, have as many refills as you'd like.

Most of it can be answered with just "yes" or "no,"
so it shouldn't take up much of your time... I think.

Besides... food always tastes better when eating with you.
So since we have the chance, I wanted us to enjoy it together...

Trainer, you always cover for what I lack.
This is the best way I can show my gratitude right now.

I need to check the questionnaire you answered,
and I'd also like some time to freshen up.

...Well, I will at least check
if they can save me some tatsuta-age and simmered dishes.
Thank you.

Still, we have to overcome it.
To achieve our goal, we must conquer the temptations close at hand.

A summer training camp at a seaside lodge, dedicated to improving our skills.
Just as we were about to begin training—

Is this all for today's routine?
I feel like I could still keep going...
Looking over the contents of the questionnaire—

Oguri Cap hurried off.
—And then.

"Do you like sweet foods?" "Do you like spicy foods?"
"Any food allergies?" It seems to consist entirely of food-related questions.

This is my first time doing something like this, so it feels a little embarrassing, but...
Please, take it.
...I see. In that case, good. I'm glad too.

If it's alright with you, I'd like to treat you today.
As a token of my daily thanks and appreciation.

Doing things half-heartedly cuts the enjoyment in half.
Let's get as much exercise in as possible to prepare for tonight.
Look at that. Quite an impressive number of stalls, isn't it?

Yeah. We're planning to check out the other stalls too, so let's start light.
If it's not enough, we can always come back.

Yes... Just as you've gotten to know me, I didn't know enough about you.
I needed to find out what would make you happy.
Alright Trainer, see you later.

Wouldn't keeping it a secret be more fitting?
What do you think, Trainer?

Thank you.
Well then, I'm counting on you.

Then let's get started.
First up is the "Super Colossal Jumbo Series."

This is incredible. Everything here truly lives up
to the jumbo name.

I scoped out the place beforehand, but... this is my first time doing this after all.
It's best if we set aside plenty of time.

Yeah, there's somewhere I want to take you.
Once you wash up, meet me in front of the training camp lodge.

Yes, you filled it out thoroughly, Trainer,
so there shouldn't be any issues. Rest easy.
Yeah. I was determined to have dinner here tonight, no matter what.

At this hour, the smell of dinner is usually drifting through the lodge hallways.
Today's menu is supposedly tatsuta-age and stewed dishes, so the aroma would be especially tempting.
Excuse me, sir. Two shaved ices and four okonomiyaki, please.
Could we get those?

The shaved ice is bucket-sized, the okonomiyaki are floor-cushion-sized...
and the takoyaki are the size of baseballs...
Oguri Cap, who usually only cares about stuffing herself, actually put together a whole survey just to plan a full-course meal for me...

Either way, I just wanted to treat you.
In my own way... with a full course planned just for you.

As you can see, there are tons of food stalls.
Plenty of your favorites too, Trainer.
I see... Yeah, let's call it for today.

If you could fill this out while I'm warming up, that'd be great.
Don't worry, it shouldn't take long.

Oguri Cap rummages through her bag and pulls out a sheet of paper.
—It appears to be a handwritten questionnaire.
We're here, Trainer.

Thanks for your help.
I'll look over it before tonight and put it to good use.

While Oguri Cap went on her warm-up run,
I filled out the questionnaire...

Thanks to her overwhelmingly generous gratitude,
I ended up so full I couldn't move for quite some time.
*pant* *pant*... Whew.
